package fixture

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestFixturePollsForTheEvent(t *testing.T) {
	wait := 30 * time.Second
	if v := os.Getenv("NOVA_TEST_WAIT"); v != "" {
		if d, err := time.ParseDuration(v); err == nil {
			wait = d
		}
	}
	deadline := time.After(wait)
	for {
		select {
		case <-deadline:
			t.Fatal("the event never arrived")
		case <-fakeNetwork():
			return
		}
	}
}
